'''Tammuz-an''' was a double-ringed [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The planet's inhabitants, called [[Tammuz-an (species)/Legends|Tammuz-an]], were tall blue- or purple-skinned [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] governed by a monarchy. The planet was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Mon Julpa]].

==History==
[[File:TammuzAn.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A view of [[Tammuz-an capital city|Tammuz-an's capital city]].]]
Four decades prior to the creation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Tammuz-an lay within the [[Tammuz sector/Legends|Tammuz sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]' territory waned in the aftermath of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], leading Tammuz-an to fall outside their borders.<ref name="TEA" /> In the early years of the Empire, a [[Vizier/Legends|vizier]] by the name of [[Ko Zatec-Cha]] wiped the memory of [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Mon Julpa]] and cast him away, usurping the throne. Eventually Mon Julpa, the true prince, returned to his homeworld and reclaimed the throne as rightful ruler of Tammuz-an.<ref name="TNK" />

Mon Julpa's next act as ruler of Tammuz-an was to put an end to the fighting between the two factions on his world. The kingdom Julpa ruled over was inhabited by the purple-skinned humanoids, while blue-skinned humanoids inhabited Lord [[Malameu Toda]]'s [[Outer Territories]].<ref name="db" /> The two races put aside their differences to vanquish [[Gir Kybo Ren-Cha]], a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] from the nearby world of [[Tarnoonga/Legends|Tarnoonga]] who had long preyed on Tammuz-an.<ref name="TPOT" /> After this brief alliance, the two factions were able to band together to create a unified Tammuz-an.<ref name="ROKR">{{DroidsCite|The Revenge of Kybo Ren}}</ref>

{{Planet-stub}}

==Tammuz-an military==
Mon Julpa and Lord Toda maintained troops within their domains, including guards armed with staff-like energy weapons.<ref name="ROKR" /> For protection along the airways, the Tammuz-an employed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] like the [[Side Gunner]] and the [[Imperial Sniper|Sniper vehicle]]. [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian]] [[Floater-935]]s and [[One-Man Sand Skimmer|airhooks]] were used for individual transport.<ref name="TNK" />
The Tammuz-an maintained a small [[Tammuz-an space navy|navy]] which supported its [[Tammuz-an shipping fleet|shipping
 fleet]] and protected Tammuz-an space.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Among the vessels used were zeppelin-shaped [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] and [[R-22 Spearhead starfighter|R-22 Spearhead]] fighters.<ref name="TPOT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The name "Tammuz" is the Hebrew form of the name of a Sumerian god (and associated month), "Dumuzid." There was a month in the Babylonian calendar named after this god. Tammuz was originally the son of Nimrod, the king who built the Tower of Babel, but later was deemed a god by his mother as he was born over nine months after Nimrod's death.

Tammuz is also the 10th month of the Jewish calendar.
